reuse.why: Extends the existing assertBankAccountNotLinked check shared by all providers and extracts the unlink field-clearing from unlinkAccount into clearAccountBankLink, reused by both paths.

duplication.why: The unlink state is defined once and used by unlinkAccount and the takeover; the per-provider edits only thread the flag.

placement.why: The logic sits in accounts/app.ts next to the existing link guard, but a function named assert... now performs the unlinking side effect, mixing validation with mutation.

scope.why: Only the link parameter type, the guard, the six provider link functions' flag pass-through, the unlink helper extraction and tests change.

maintainability.why: Clear single place for the rule and the unlinked state; the misleading assert name and the six-fold manual flag threading are minor costs.
